macros.name: wfronttrue
macros.doc: By default the dot appears after the character (as for West Cree), but can be made to appear before it (as for East Cree) by \wfronttrue (back by \wfrontfalse).

envs.name: syllab
envs.doc: The typesetting of Cree/Inuktitut text is done by the environment syllab.
